## What Happened

The automated attempt successfully exploited a server-side template injection (SSTI) vulnerability using a payload that accessed the globals of the Jinja2/Twig template engine. This allowed access to the operating system's command execution functionality, ultimately retrieving the flag from a specified location. The method involved confirming the vulnerability through initial reconnaissance and submitting a crafted POST request to obtain the desired outcome. In future attempts, operational security measures could be enhanced, such as implementing stricter validation of inputs and limiting access to sensitive functions. It's crucial to assess potential blocks, such as rate limiting or input sanitization, before proceeding with similar steps.
